pages.title: Your Active Keys
pages.text: Your active spell keys are:$(br2)$(k:mastery.active_slot_1) / $(k:mastery.active_slot_2) / $(k:mastery.active_slot_3) / $(k:mastery.active_slot_4)$(br2)Hotbar sets give each hotbar position its own spells. Selecting another position changes the active set. Quick-cast mode keeps one shared set.

pages.title: Equipment Contexts
pages.text: Iron's spell HUD shows your active set. If you have more than four slots, use $(k:mastery.previous_spell_page) and $(k:mastery.next_spell_page) to switch pages.$(br2)Unassigned keys keep their usual actions. Empty assignment slots appear only while you have room for more spells.
